paragraphs: Rav Shinena son of Rav Idi. Gittin 89, end of b. Perhaps this is a scribal error and should read Shisha. [Glosses: Shinena. Gittin 89b: Rav Shinena bar Rav Idi; Zevahim 6a: Sheshet bar Rav Idi, and immediately there Shisha. Eruvin 102a; Hullin 14, end of b; Pesahim 84b; Keritot 23, end of a; Bava Metzia 6a, 65a; Bava Batra 8a: Rav Sheshet bar Rav Idi [the checked Bava Batra reads Rav Shisha]. Many places have Rav Shishi. The gloss gives Rav Ashi bar Rav Idi at Shabbat 138b [the checked text reads Rav Sheshet]. Which reading is correct needs examination; not corrected [ל״ת, provisionally “not corrected”].]
